::: {.callout-note}
## Working research proposition
The commissioning brief places Creekview around 1985 and a Creekview evaluation around 1987. Those dates are not verified from an inspected source in this archive.
:::

## What this chapter is for

Later work can reconstruct what Creekview was, who documented it, and how later writers connect it to ECPM or CSIL. This page does not assert that relationship as fact.

## Evidence status

- **Documented facts:** none recorded on this page yet.
- **Bibliographically confirmed (copy sought):** [Creekview 202 Project Evaluation Report](../sources/wanted-creekview-202-evaluation.qmd), named as a known-to-exist document (Patricia Ryan / Ryan & Wiggins, c. 1987).
- **Open questions:** the institutional setting of Creekview; whether “202” is a project code; how the evaluation was circulated.
